title: ECB Holds Rates at 2.00% — Unanimous Decision Despite Internal Hike Debate
detail: The ECB Governing Council voted unanimously to hold its key interest rates unchanged: deposit facility rate at 2.00%, main refinancing operations at 2.15%, marginal lending facility at 2.40%. ECB President Christine Lagarde confirmed that a rate hike had been 'discussed at length' during the meeting due to surging energy prices driven by Middle East conflict, but the Council ultimately chose to maintain its current stance pending more data. Financial markets now price in multiple rate hikes later in 2026, with a likely first move expected at the June 2026 meeting. The decision came alongside continued ECB concern over energy price pass-through to core inflation.

title: EU Confirms EU-Mercosur Interim Deal to Enter Provisional Application from 1 May
detail: The European Commission confirmed that the EU-Mercosur Interim Trade Agreement would enter into provisional application on May 1, 2026, following completion of domestic ratification procedures in all four Mercosur states (Argentina, Brazil, Uruguay, and Paraguay). This marks the effective start date of the world's largest trade deal by population — covering over 700 million people. EU exporters of cars, pharmaceuticals, wine, spirits, and olive oil will gain immediate tariff reductions. The provisional application covers the trade pillar of the agreement; full ratification by all EU member state parliaments, including a CJEU opinion, is still pending and could take up to two years.
